Former Chinese Premier Zhu Rongji Dies at 97

Former Chinese Premier Zhu Rongji has died at the age of 97. State media reported his death. Zhu Rongji is credited with driving significant economic reforms in China during the 1990s, transforming the country into a global economic power. He played a key role in negotiating China's entry into the World Trade Organization (WTO) and championed reforms that fueled economic growth and transitioned China towards a more market-oriented financial system while maintaining party control.
